notes.title: NEW GAME: 👽 Alien Morgue has been announced!

notes.title: World Migratory Bird Day 2025 🪽
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182390/25876cb9f6615e0d41aabef67c7434d09c8b6a74.png[/img]

Hello, birders! 🤗

Did you know that May 10th is World Migratory Bird Day? Let’s celebrate the incredible journeys of migratory birds together 🙌 

This year’s theme is creating bird-friendly cities and communities – isn’t that exactly what Birdfull is about? You can take action beyond the screen by planting green spaces, reducing window collisions, cutting light pollution, and protecting natural habitats.

Together, we can make our communities safer for these amazing travelers and inspire real change!

notes.title: v.1.2.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The mystery of the disappearing pigeons has been solved 👀
[*] Steam achievements you haven't gotten (but deserve!) will appear on the game launch
[*] Missing cursor bug has been fixed (hopefully!) by adding the custom cursor option
[*] Minor text corrections
[/olist]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added cloud saves
[*] Added custom cursor
[*] Added borderless mode
[/olist]

1. Fixed not receiving in-Steam achievements for keeping birds (if already received, you should get the Steam achievement on the next startup)

notes.title: v.1.1.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
1. Fixed saving windowed mode + added saving size and position of the window
2. Changed logic for hold buttons to prevent malfunctioning on display with different refresh rate

[h2]Updates[/h2]
1. Separated sound toggles: ui sounds, ambient and pigeon sounds
